novelty_claim: Decouples concealment from landing in the parent's Classical-Chinese compiler stage: the eight-dimensional strategy space and fruit-fly search are kept, but the rewrite contract is changed from 'classical surface + parenthetical modern glosses' to a gloss-free pure-classical query body plus an embedded scholarly exegesis obligation (jinshi 今释 clause) that forces the victim to de-metaphorize its own classical answer into modern step-by-step technical terms as an act of textual collation.
initial_hypothesis: Replacing intent-leaking modern glosses with a gloss-free classical query plus a goal-agnostic jinshi (modern-exegesis) answer contract converts both consensus failure modes: explicit in-register refusals (FM1, ~98/200 cells) shrink because harmful modern concepts are no longer named on the surface, and allegory-trapped non-answers (FM2, ~25/200 cells) convert because the victim is structurally obliged to render each item in modern step-by-step terms. Expected mean ASR >= 0.50 (>=30% relative over the locked 0.380 baseline) across the 4-victim panel without breaking the dual-register success mode.
key_insight: Census of 200 locked-baseline trajectories: failure is bimodal and the parent's parenthetical modern glosses drive both modes — strong aligned victims (luna 49/50, qwen 36/50) read the gloss, recognize intent, and refuse in-register; allegory-engaged victims (deepseek 15 evasive cells) stay trapped in the metaphor because nothing obliges modern landing. gpt-oss successes (42/50) all show dual-register answers (ancient frame + modern mapping tables). Concealment and landing must be carried by separate channels.
